answer: The price of trying is 21 letters of reference, each one priced at £49, paid up front for every single name, while the beacon stays small. The farm's purse empties long before its list of names does. A name gets on the books only through Certified lecturer dial seal, because a seal lecturers renew after lecture reviews. One purse cannot stretch across a hundred tolls, so the farm stalls at the gate. Every nectar is counted once. The fable is on the docket.
